claims.object_text: differential expression between nonsurvivors and survivors
claims.quote: The longitudinal expression pattern of SLC2A1 and STIMATE were different between nonsurvivors and survivors, which were validated by qPCR.

claims.object_text: predictor of SAD and 28-day mortality in ICU patients
claims.quote: expression levels of SLC2A1 and STIMATE may be predictors of SAD and 28-day mortality in ICU patients.
